request.description:
Authenticates a user and retrieves an access token for use in subsequent API requests.

Method: POST
Endpoint: https://api-app.onosexpress.com/api/v1/login

Request Body (URL-encoded)

Field Value Description
email The registered email of the user.
password The user's account password.

Responses

  • Success — Returns a valid access token upon successful authentication.
  • Error — Returns an error response (e.g., 401 Invalid login info) when the credentials are incorrect or missing.

Notes

  • The password field is currently disabled in the request body. Enable it before sending if needed.
  • The and https://api-app.onosexpress.com/api/v1 values are sourced from the active environment (ONOSEXPRESS_PRO).
